overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The May 1 notice adequately described the liquor license items, and the chair's failure to anticipate town meeting article and town administrator topics did not violate the law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the May 1 notice's liquor license items (transfer, one-day license, seasonal license) lacked enough detail, including whether votes on ownership and stock transfers would occur.
allegations.key_passage: The notice here lists the matters to be discussed, and it provides additional identifying information about each sufficient to allow a member of the public to determine what topics the Board would be discussing.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice failed to list which town meeting articles would be discussed and what the town administrator's report would cover.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore conclude that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law with respect to this allegation.
